_readme: Stage-2 extractor output: the build-tier LLM's contribution to the pipeline. Actions select SOURCE STEP INDICES (ADR-001), never step text, so no step can exist that is absent from the SIIS document. Screen descriptors are written in catalog register (ADR-002) because Stage 3 resolves that register at ~100% precision; free-form phrasing degrades to ~50%. Committed because LLM calls are not reproducible; everything downstream of this file is deterministic.

_anchors_note: Each stepGroup carries a sha1-prefix per referenced step, captured when the skeleton was authored. compile_plans.py verifies them: step indices are positions in the segmenter output, so any change to is_actionable renumbers candidates and would otherwise silently repoint every skeleton to different steps. The build fails loudly instead.
